newsitem.title: USA: American Re names George O'Shaughnessy CFO.
newsitem.headline: American Re names George O'Shaughnessy CFO.

text.p: American Re Corp said Wednesday it had named Senior Vice President George O'Shaughnessy as chief financial officer of American Re and its unit American Re-Insurance Company.
O'Shaughnessy replaces James Fisher, whose resignation at the end of March was announced by the company in January.
He has been Senior Vice President and Corporate Controller since January 1995. A company spokeswoman said he will remain corporate controller.
American Re is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Munich Reinsurance Co. It was bought out by the German reinsurer last year in a $3.3 billion deal.
